files.description: Complete HTML source of the B10 Export Documentation page. Contains the full export documentation: process description, per-patient manifest JSON schema (4 fields: Descripton, FileName, FileType, DateCreated), and bulk export manifest JSON schema (12 fields: patient demographics + ZIP file reference). The schemas are embedded as syntax-highlighted inline spans, not standalone downloads.
files.curl_command: curl -sL 'https://www.mdlogic.com/solutions/b10-export-documentation' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36' -o downloads/b10-export-documentation.html

files.description: Extracted JSON Schema for the per-patient manifest.json file. Describes an array of objects with 4 required fields: Descripton (document description, e.g. 'MRI Spine', 'Progress Notes'), FileName (e.g. 'testFile_51.pdf'), FileType ('Word', 'PDF', 'CCDA', 'JPEG'), DateCreated (M/D/YYYY string). Extracted from inline HTML; trailing comma bug in original was fixed.

Extracted JSON Schema for the bulk (all-patients) export manifest. Describes an array of objects with 12 required fields: patient demographics (FirstName, LastName, MiddleName, Suffix, Address1, Address2, City, State, Zip, Gender, DOB) plus PatientFileName (reference to patient's ZIP file, e.g. '5125.zip'). Note: schema has bugs — required array lists 'Address' but property is 'Address1'; Gender is required but has no property definition.
